newsitem.title: USA: AIG unit lifts limits on employment cover.
newsitem.headline: AIG unit lifts limits on employment cover.

text.p: American International Group Inc said its New Hampshire Insurance Co has increased the limits of liability for its middle market employment practices liability insurance to $10 million, up from five million.

The policy, which is targeted to employers with less than 500 employees, provides coverage for claims alleging discrimination, sexual harassment, failure to employ or promote, or wrongful termination or discipline.
The employment practices coverage protects the corporate entity, directors, officers and other current or future employees.
Coverage is triggered by an allegation, AIG said.

"New legislation and increased publicity surrounding employment-related litigation has caused more employers to examine their potential workplace liabilities," said Stan Galanski, president of New Hampshire Insurance.
"These increased limits respond to the needs of small and mid-sized companies that are addressing this growing exposure," he said.
